cond_0001.intro: A Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist at [Company name masked] provides regulatory guidance to support strategic and innovative business priorities. This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, or food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field
Strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions
Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization
Excellent attention to detail for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.

Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging

cond_0010.intro: A Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist at [Company name masked] provides regulatory guidance to support strategic and innovative business priorities. This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0010.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0010.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role delivers critical support to the business by applying technical knowledge of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role ensures our products, including supplements, are backed by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will apply knowledge of federal and state regulations to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis on product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will take ownership of primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0071.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Lead regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements, ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Drive ecommerce projects and innovation for internal customers.
Deliver clear written and verbal responses to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Direct regulatory guidance on ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Execute regulatory input to guide the business.
Access and research applicable regulations; lead horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to determine product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Deliver training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Manage multiple projects and set strategic direction to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Lead trade association work group participation and ensure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into objectives and actions. Execute various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0071.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role delivers critical support to the business by applying technical knowledge of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role ensures our products, including supplements, are backed by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow our competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will apply knowledge of federal and state regulations to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling, with a strong emphasis on product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will take primary ownership of [Location masked] SRA projects and provide secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0206.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Lead regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements, ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Drive ecommerce projects and innovation for internal customers.
Deliver clear written and verbal responses to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Direct regulatory guidance on ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Execute regulatory input to guide the business.
Access and research applicable regulations; lead horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to determine product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Deliver training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Manage multiple projects and set strategic direction to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives in Pet Food Trade Associations.
Lead trade association work group participation and ensure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into objectives and actions. Execute various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0206.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, or food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field
Strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into practical business application
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to develop and maintain collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues and cross-functional partners
Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly communicate complex or sensitive information across levels and functions
Excellent attention to detail, including interpreting and applying regulations and label development
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify priorities and drive work to completion
Ability to function independently and as part of a team
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, or food science
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business
Experience in pet food
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging
A genuine interest in pets and strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and overcome barriers when advising R&D and commercial partners

This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works alongside the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will work with colleagues using knowledge of federal and state regulations to help ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling, with a strong emphasis on product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0261.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Coordinate regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements, ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Work alongside internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Share regulatory guidance with colleagues on ingredients and claims strategy to help ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Work with the business to provide regulatory input that guides decisions.
Access and research applicable regulations, and support horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Coordinate training on label compliance with R&D and Marketing associates.
Help manage multiple projects and work with the team to navigate the regulations strategically.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and work alongside colleagues to ensure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions. Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0261.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field
Strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions
Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization
Excellent attention to detail for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion
Preferred Requirements
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business
Experience in pet food
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team

This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0316.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0316.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how regulations apply to product claims and labeling.
cond_0391.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0391.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

This position has regular exposure to many parts of the business and involves daily cross-functional work with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role provides critical support to the business by applying technical knowledge of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. It helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will use knowledge of federal and state regulations to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling, with a strong emphasis on product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0411.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements, ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Regularly connect with internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies, including explaining complex or sensitive information clearly across levels and functions.
Provide regulatory guidance on ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Access and research applicable regulations, and actively share horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Deliver training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates, walking them through requirements and handling questions.
Manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Actively participate in trade association work groups, initiate discussions to ensure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0411.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

cond_0442.intro: A Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist at [Company name masked] provides regulatory guidance to support strategic and innovative business priorities. This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0442.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0442.requirements:
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field.
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners.
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business is highly desired. This role requires strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application.
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills are required to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization.
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging.
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team.
Excellent attention to detail is required for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion.
Experience in pet food.
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field.
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science

cond_0451.intro: A Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist at [Company name masked] provides regulatory guidance to support strategic and innovative business priorities. This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical mastery of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects.
cond_0451.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, or food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field
Strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions
Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization
Excellent attention to detail for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners
Preferred Requirements
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team
Experience in pet food
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, or food science

This position has exposure to many parts of the business and works cross-functionally with the eCommerce team, Legal, Research & Development, Marketing, Nutrition, Commercial and Supply Teams. This role will provide critical support to the business by applying technical knowledge of pet nutrition and scientific claims to support our brands across the organization. This role helps ensure our products, including supplements, are supported by the most current and accurate science to maintain and grow the competitive market position. The Senior Regulatory Affairs Scientist will utilize knowledge of federal and state regulations guidelines to ensure compliance and substantiation of [Company name masked] product labeling with a strong emphasis in product claims and eCommerce advertising. The position will provide primary support for [Location masked] SRA projects and secondary support for [Location masked] SRA projects. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp how regulations apply to product claims and labeling.
cond_0526.responsibilities:
Regulatory Compliance
Provide regulatory review and approval of packaging and advertising materials for pet food and supplements ensuring appropriate support for all claims. Supporting internal customers on ecommerce projects and innovation.
Strong written and verbal communication skills required to respond effectively to internal stakeholders and regulatory agencies.
Provide regulatory guidance with ingredients and claims strategy to ensure they are accurately supported and properly described on labels and advertising.
Provide regulatory input to guide the business.
Ability to access and research applicable regulations, horizon scanning of regulated consumer goods to assist with product proposition, labelling, regulatory strategy and claim support.
Provide training on label compliance to R&D and Marketing associates.
Ability to manage multiple projects and think strategically to navigate the regulations.
Represent Company Objectives In Pet Food Trade Associations.
Participate in trade association work groups and assure [Company name masked] strategies are incorporated into the objectives and actions.
Perform various other regulatory functions as needed.
cond_0526.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
M.S. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, biochemistry, food science
Minimum 2 years' experience in animal health and nutritional field
Strong analytical thinking skills and the ability to interpret complex regulations into creative business application
Strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to actively develop and maintain strong collaborative working relationships with Regulatory colleagues around the world and with partners in other functions
Strong written and verbal communication skills to clearly communicate potentially complex or sensitive information in a factual, non-speculative manner, across levels and functions in the organization
Excellent attention to detail for many aspects of this role including interpreting and applying regulations, label development etc.
Excellent project management skills, with the ability to identify what needs to be done and the ownership to drive the work to completion
Ability to function independently in a multi-task environment, as well as a part of a dynamic team
Preferred Requirements
Ph.D. In animal/biological sciences, nutrition, food science
5+ Years of experience in animal health and nutrition field
Previous regulatory experience or experience in an FDA business
Experience in pet food
A pet passionate person with excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to identify and overcome barriers to deliver guidance to R&D and commercial partners
Experience with sustainability claims support as it relates to ingredients and packaging
